items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And just with our PR person, Virginia Wiggs, and it’s a big expense and he’s invested a lot and he’s like a little angel for us.

ctx.x: I think it’s a good role model for people, that there’s lots of different ways to make a living in music and sometimes you have to do all of them.

Yeah. With the performance aspect though we’re really lucky to have Stanley. Like no kidding. We could have a million big bands but he really knows the business part very well and he was willing to invest a lot of his money to get us rolling. I mean we commission all of our own music, all of our music is original to us, both the small group and the big band. And just with our PR person, Virginia Wiggs, and it’s a big expense and he’s invested a lot and he’s like a little angel for us. So we’re lucky for that.
Great. Well thanks for your time today.
